As of ~12:52 ET, the running max has reached 69.8°F — already above the NWS point forecast of 69°F — and the temperature is still trending upward with positive 30-minute (+3.1°F/hr) and 2-hour (+1.8°F/hr) velocities. The META model's center of mass sits near 73-74°F, consistent with the HRRR/ECMWF average of ~71.7°F plus modest residual warming; the NWS 69°F point forecast is already obsolete. Confidence is moderate — the ensemble signals are broadly diffuse (Tier 4, no-trade recommendation) with meaningful spread across the 70-76°F range, but the evidence leans toward a final TMAX near 73°F.
